title: Intruders in intergalactic school world
content: Hello everyone, i will try to keep it short. I don’t usually post on reddit but i would like to hear your experiences. maybe someone could help me interpret. I used to dream of a school. An inter-dimensional/intergalactic academy of sorts. It has the atmosphere of a futuristic but practical modern day school. With a cafeteria, halls, classrooms, labs. The students were from all around the galaxy. Alien species i haven’t seen anywhere. Also a lot of humans like myself. I kept dreaming of this school throughout years. We were all gathered to learn about subjects that we cant learn in the real world. We were attending classes regularly but i couldn’t remember what was taught when i wake up or how my friends from this place looked like. The last time i dreamt of this school was 2 years ago. It was a regular school day until a group of people crashed in with a vehicle of sorts through the hallway ceiling. There was panic and the security came quickly to stop the intruders. What i cant get out of my mind is there was a young man among the intruders. He stated that he was looking to rescue his sister. But he didn’t know what she looked like here. And when i looked at his face i just knew he was my brother. He had dark wavy hair and a slim posture. He was searching amongst the crowd with his eyes and when he saw me from afar i heard his voice in my head. “i will find you no matter what.” Normally i would wake up from school world relaxed and happy. Like I actually learned something and spent time with friends. But this time when he said his last words i woke up to a sleep paralysis. Like i woke up too early or i was forced to wake up. And i haven’t been there since this incident. Even if i did i cant remember it. Has anyone remember attending this school too? Was there any similar event you went through? This might just be my subconscious but i had other encounters and experiences to suspect there might be more to this. Thanks in advance
